Description: A mixed curated-and-lexical knowledge base. Curated entries provide concise concept descriptions and selected capabilities/mechanisms; lexical entries describe only the supplied vocabulary metadata and are intentionally lower-trust for factual answering.
Safety_Rules: Associations are hints for retrieval, not proof of a factual relation.
Lexical entries must not be promoted to factual definitions without curated support.
When a proposition is unsupported, Decoder.js should express uncertainty instead of fabricating a relation.
Generated text may update recurrent activation but is not automatically stored as trusted knowledge.

SKILL001.Name: Definition answering
SKILL001.Policy: Prefer an exact curated concept description. If only lexical metadata exists, identify it as lexical information rather than presenting it as a world fact.

SKILL002.Name: Yes or no answering
SKILL002.Policy: Use capability or relation evidence when available. If the data does not establish the proposition, answer with uncertainty rather than inventing a yes.

SKILL003.Name: Mechanism answering
SKILL003.Policy: Prefer Mechanism fields and ordered process relations. Do not replace missing mechanism data with lexical association alone.

SKILL004.Name: Causal answering
SKILL004.Policy: Prefer explicit causal relations. Mere related_to associations are not sufficient evidence of causation.

SKILL005.Name: Lexical diversity
SKILL005.Policy: Within one clause, reject a content candidate when its Root_Family is already occupied unless Processor.js marks an explicit exception.

SKILL006.Name: Confidence separation
SKILL006.Policy: Candidate preference is not epistemic confidence. Confidence is reduced when retrieval is lexical-only or when proposition support is incomplete.

TR000080.Subject: temperature
TR000080.Description: Temperature is a measure related to the average kinetic energy of particles in a system and is used to describe how hot or cold something is.
TR000080.Long_Definition: Temperature is a measure related to the average kinetic energy of particles in a system and is used to describe how hot or cold something is. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include heat, weather.

TR000081.Subject: pressure
TR000081.Description: Pressure is force distributed over area. In the atmosphere, pressure reflects the weight and motion of air above a surface.
TR000081.Long_Definition: Pressure is force distributed over area. In the atmosphere, pressure reflects the weight and motion of air above a surface. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include force, weather.

TR000082.Subject: humidity
TR000082.Description: Humidity describes the amount of water vapor present in air.
TR000082.Long_Definition: Humidity describes the amount of water vapor present in air. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include weather, atmosphere.

TR000083.Subject: cloud
TR000083.Description: A cloud is a visible collection of tiny water droplets, ice crystals, or both suspended in the atmosphere.
TR000083.Long_Definition: A cloud is a visible collection of tiny water droplets, ice crystals, or both suspended in the atmosphere. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include weather, water.

TR000084.Subject: rain
TR000084.Description: Rain is liquid water precipitation that falls from clouds to the surface.
TR000084.Long_Definition: Rain is liquid water precipitation that falls from clouds to the surface. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include precipitation, weather.

TR000085.Subject: snow
TR000085.Description: Snow is precipitation consisting primarily of ice crystals that form in cold atmospheric conditions.
TR000085.Long_Definition: Snow is precipitation consisting primarily of ice crystals that form in cold atmospheric conditions. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include precipitation, weather.

TR000086.Subject: hurricane
TR000086.Description: A hurricane is a mature tropical cyclone with sustained winds meeting the hurricane threshold used by the relevant meteorological agency.
TR000086.Long_Definition: A hurricane is a mature tropical cyclone with sustained winds meeting the hurricane threshold used by the relevant meteorological agency. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include storm, weather.

TR000087.Subject: tornado
TR000087.Description: A tornado is a violently rotating column of air extending from a thunderstorm to the ground.
TR000087.Long_Definition: A tornado is a violently rotating column of air extending from a thunderstorm to the ground. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include storm, weather.

TR000088.Subject: wind
TR000088.Description: Wind is the movement of air relative to the Earth, driven largely by pressure gradients and influenced by rotation, friction, and terrain.
TR000088.Long_Definition: Wind is the movement of air relative to the Earth, driven largely by pressure gradients and influenced by rotation, friction, and terrain. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include weather, pressure.

TR000089.Subject: energy
TR000089.Description: Energy is a conserved physical quantity associated with the capacity of a system to produce change or perform work.
TR000089.Long_Definition: Energy is a conserved physical quantity associated with the capacity of a system to produce change or perform work. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include work, power.

TR000090.Subject: power
TR000090.Description: Power is the rate at which work is done or energy is transferred.
TR000090.Long_Definition: Power is the rate at which work is done or energy is transferred. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include energy, time.

TR000091.Subject: force
TR000091.Description: Force is an interaction that can change an object's momentum; in classical mechanics it is often related to mass and acceleration.
TR000091.Long_Definition: Force is an interaction that can change an object's momentum; in classical mechanics it is often related to mass and acceleration. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include mass, acceleration.

TR000092.Subject: speed
TR000092.Description: Speed is the magnitude of velocity and describes distance traveled per unit of time.
TR000092.Long_Definition: Speed is the magnitude of velocity and describes distance traveled per unit of time. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include velocity, time.

TR000093.Subject: velocity
TR000093.Description: Velocity describes the rate of change of position and includes both magnitude and direction.
TR000093.Long_Definition: Velocity describes the rate of change of position and includes both magnitude and direction. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include speed, direction.

TR000094.Subject: acceleration
TR000094.Description: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity with respect to time.
TR000094.Long_Definition: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity with respect to time. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include velocity, time.

TR000095.Subject: mass
TR000095.Description: Mass is a physical quantity associated with inertia and gravitational interaction.
TR000095.Long_Definition: Mass is a physical quantity associated with inertia and gravitational interaction. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include force, gravity.

TR000096.Subject: gravity
TR000096.Description: Gravity is the interaction by which masses and energy influence motion and spacetime; near everyday scales it produces attraction toward massive bodies.
TR000096.Long_Definition: Gravity is the interaction by which masses and energy influence motion and spacetime; near everyday scales it produces attraction toward massive bodies. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include mass, force.

TR000097.Subject: time
TR000097.Description: Time is a dimension used to order events and measure durations and change.
TR000097.Long_Definition: Time is a dimension used to order events and measure durations and change. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include event.

TR000098.Subject: atom
TR000098.Description: An atom is the basic unit of a chemical element, consisting of a nucleus surrounded by electrons.
TR000098.Long_Definition: An atom is the basic unit of a chemical element, consisting of a nucleus surrounded by electrons. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include electron, nucleus.

TR000099.Subject: molecule
TR000099.Description: A molecule is a group of atoms held together by chemical bonds and behaving as a unit.
TR000099.Long_Definition: A molecule is a group of atoms held together by chemical bonds and behaving as a unit. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include atom, bond.

TR000100.Subject: electron
TR000100.Description: An electron is a fundamental particle with negative electric charge.
TR000100.Long_Definition: An electron is a fundamental particle with negative electric charge. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include atom, charge.

TR000101.Subject: photon
TR000101.Description: A photon is a quantum of the electromagnetic field and carries electromagnetic energy and momentum.
TR000101.Long_Definition: A photon is a quantum of the electromagnetic field and carries electromagnetic energy and momentum. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include light, quantum.

TR000102.Subject: quantum
TR000102.Description: Quantum refers to discrete physical quantities and the framework of quantum mechanics used to describe microscopic systems.
TR000102.Long_Definition: Quantum refers to discrete physical quantities and the framework of quantum mechanics used to describe microscopic systems. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include photon, probability.

TR000103.Subject: data
TR000103.Description: Data is recorded information represented in a form that can be stored, transmitted, or processed.
TR000103.Long_Definition: Data is recorded information represented in a form that can be stored, transmitted, or processed. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include memory, JSON.

TR000104.Subject: information
TR000104.Description: Information is structured content that reduces uncertainty or conveys distinctions about a system, event, or message.
TR000104.Long_Definition: Information is structured content that reduces uncertainty or conveys distinctions about a system, event, or message. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include data, signal.

TR000105.Subject: signal
TR000105.Description: A signal is a varying quantity used to carry information or represent a state change.
TR000105.Long_Definition: A signal is a varying quantity used to carry information or represent a state change. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include information, activation.

TR000106.Subject: computer
TR000106.Description: A computer is a programmable electronic system that stores and processes information according to instructions.
TR000106.Long_Definition: A computer is a programmable electronic system that stores and processes information according to instructions. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include CPU, memory, software.

TR000107.Subject: program
TR000107.Description: A program is a sequence of instructions and data structures that direct a computer to perform tasks.
TR000107.Long_Definition: A program is a sequence of instructions and data structures that direct a computer to perform tasks. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include algorithm, computer.

TR000108.Subject: browser
TR000108.Description: A web browser is software that retrieves, executes, and displays web content including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Web APIs.
TR000108.Long_Definition: A web browser is software that retrieves, executes, and displays web content including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Web APIs. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include HTML, JavaScript, WebGPU.

TR000109.Subject: local storage
TR000109.Description: Local storage is browser-managed persistent key-value storage scoped to an origin.
TR000109.Long_Definition: Local storage is browser-managed persistent key-value storage scoped to an origin. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include browser, persistence.

TR000110.Subject: persistence
TR000110.Description: Persistence is the ability to retain data or learned state beyond the lifetime of a single operation or in-memory session.
TR000110.Long_Definition: Persistence is the ability to retain data or learned state beyond the lifetime of a single operation or in-memory session. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include storage, memory.

TR000111.Subject: namespace
TR000111.Description: A namespace separates identifiers so data or symbols from different systems or versions do not collide.
TR000111.Long_Definition: A namespace separates identifiers so data or symbols from different systems or versions do not collide. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include storage, schema.

TR000112.Subject: schema
TR000112.Description: A schema defines the expected structure, fields, types, and version rules of stored or exchanged data.
TR000112.Long_Definition: A schema defines the expected structure, fields, types, and version rules of stored or exchanged data. Closely related concepts in this knowledge entry include JSON, storage.

Role: Semantic knowledge and long-form definition store for VilotNI 2 Ultra. Text here is source meaning, not a response bank.

Knowledge_Policy.Lexical_Realization: Decoder builds a semantic response frame, then Words.json provides the words used to express it.
Knowledge_Policy.Pure_VilotNI_2: VilotNI 2 does not query TrainingInfo.json during a normal generation turn; Ultra enables this semantic source on the same shared model.
Knowledge_Policy.Provenance: Ultra retrieval is turn-scoped, while RSL learning remains shared because VilotNI 2 and VilotNI 2 Ultra are the same persistent model.
